description:
Akaunting helps small businesses and freelancers handle everyday accounting in one place. Create and send invoices, record income and expenses, and keep an organised view of your accounts so you always know where your business stands.

With Akaunting, you can invoice customers and track payment status, log expenses with categories and tags, and connect bank accounts to streamline reconciliation. You can also run financial reports, such as profit & loss and cash flow, to understand performance over time.

Designed for practical bookkeeping, Akaunting gives you a clear, straightforward way to stay on top of billing, costs, and reporting — without extra complexity.
